quotes.author: David Brainerd

quotes.quote: Oh no. Don't smile. You'll kill me. I stop breathing when you smile.
quotes.author: Tessa Dare,  A Lady of Persuasion

quotes.quote: With mirth and laughter let old wrinkles come.
quotes.author: William Shakespeare,  The Merchant of Venice

quotes.quote: I am the happiest creature in the world. Perhaps other people have said so before, but not one with such justice. I am happier even than Jane; she only smiles, I laugh.
quotes.author: Jane Austen,  Pride and Prejudice

quotes.quote: Actual happiness always looks pretty squalid in comparison with the overcompensations for misery. And, of course, stability isn't nearly so spectacular as instability. And being contented has none of the glamour of a good fight against misfortune, none of the picturesqueness of a struggle with temptation, or a fatal overthrow by passion or doubt. Happiness is never grand.
quotes.author: Aldous Huxley,  Brave New World

quotes.quote: Those who are not looking for happiness are the most likely to find it, because those who are searching forget that the surest way to be happy is to seek happiness for others.
quotes.author: Martin Luther King Jr.

quotes.quote: Success is getting and achieving what you want. Happiness is wanting and being content with what you get.
quotes.author: Bernard Meltzer

quotes.quote: Happiness is the natural flower of duty.
quotes.author: Phillips Brooks

quotes.quote: It's so curious: one can resist tears and 'behave' very well in the hardest hours of grief. But then someone makes you a friendly sign behind a window, or one notices that a flower that was in bud only yesterday has suddenly blossomed, or a letter slips from a drawer... and everything collapses.
quotes.author: Colette

quotes.quote: The secret of happiness is freedom, the secret of freedom is courage.
quotes.author: Carrie Jones,  Need

quotes.quote: Happily ever after, or even just together ever after, is not cheesy,' Wren said. 'It's the noblest, like, the most courageous thing two people can shoot for.
quotes.author: Rainbow Rowell,  Fangirl

quotes.quote: I do not miss childhood, but I miss the way I took pleasure in small things, even as greater things crumbled. I could not control the world I was in, could not walk away from things or people or moments that hurt, but I took joy in the things that made me happy.
quotes.author: Neil Gaiman,  The Ocean at the End of the Lane

quotes.quote: The true secret of happiness lies in taking a genuine interest in all the details of daily life.
quotes.author: William Morris

quotes.quote: It is the very mark of the spirit of rebellion to crave for happiness in this life
quotes.author: Henrik Ibsen,  Ghosts

quotes.quote: There is nothing more rare, nor more beautiful, than a woman being unapologetically herself; comfortable in her perfect imperfection. To me, that is the true essence of beauty.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: When you do what you fear most, then you can do anything.
quotes.author: Stephen Richards

quotes.quote: True happiness is to enjoy the present, without anxious dependence upon the future, not to amuse ourselves with either hopes or fears but to rest satisfied with what we have, which is sufficient, for he that is so wants nothing. The greatest blessings of mankind are within us and within our reach. A wise man is content with his lot, whatever it may be, without wishing for what he has not.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.quote: A quiet secluded life in the country, with the possibility of being useful to people to whom it is easy to do good, and who are not accustomed to have it done to them; then work which one hopes may be of some use; then rest, nature, books, music, love for one's neighbor -- such is my idea of happiness.
quotes.author: Leo Tolstoy,  Family Happiness

quotes.quote: I'm choosing happiness over suffering, I know I am. I'm making space for the unknown future to fill up my life with yet-to-come surprises.
quotes.author: Elizabeth Gilbert,  Eat, Pray, Love

quotes.quote: Whoever is happy will make others happy.
quotes.author: Anne Frank,  The Diary of a Young Girl

quotes.quote: There are two ways to get enough. One is to continue to accumulate more and more. The other is to desire less.
quotes.author: G.K. Chesterton

quotes.quote: I think happiness is what makes you pretty. Period. Happy people are beautiful. They become like a mirror and they reflect that happiness.
quotes.author: Drew Barrymore

quotes.quote: Today I choose life. Every morning when I wake up I can choose joy, happiness, negativity, pain... To feel the freedom that comes from being able to continue to make mistakes and choices - today I choose to feel life, not to deny my humanity but embrace it.
quotes.author: Kevyn Aucoin

quotes.quote: A mathematical formula for happiness:Reality divided by Expectations.There were two ways to be happy:improve your reality or lower your expectations.
quotes.author: Jodi Picoult,  Nineteen Minutes

quotes.quote: I love those who can smile in trouble, who can gather strength from distress, and grow brave by reflection. 'Tis the business of little minds to shrink, but they whose heart is firm, and whose conscience approves their conduct, will pursue their principles unto death.
quotes.author: Leonardo da Vinci

quotes.quote: He was mastered by the sheer surging of life, the tidal wave of being, the perfect joy of each separate muscle, joint, and sinew in that it was everything that was not death, that it was aglow and rampant, expressing itself in movement, flying exultantly under the stars.
quotes.author: Jack London,  The Call of the Wild

quotes.quote: Always keep your smile. That's how I explain my long life.
quotes.author: Jeanne Calment

quotes.quote: If I saw you hitchhiking, I'd smile and return your thumb's up, just for you doing such a great job of being a positive roadside influence.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz

quotes.quote: Keep your best wishes, close to your heart and watch what happens
quotes.author: Tony DeLiso,  Legacy: The Power Within

quotes.quote: Happiness is a choice. You can choose to be happy. There's going to be stress in life, but it's your choice whether you let it affect you or not.
quotes.author: Valerie Bertinelli

quotes.quote: Red is such an interesting color to correlate with emotion, because it's on both ends of the spectrum. On one end you have happiness, falling in love, infatuation with someone, passion, all that. On the other end, you've got obsession, jealousy, danger, fear, anger and frustration.
quotes.author: Taylor Swift

quotes.quote: This planet has - or rather had - a problem, which was this: most of the people living on it were unhappy for pretty much of the time. Many solutions were suggested for this problem, but most of these were largely concerned with the movement of small green pieces of paper, which was odd because on the whole it wasn't the small green pieces of paper that were unhappy.
quotes.author: Douglas Adams,  The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy

quotes.quote: With all its sham, drudgery, and broken dreams,it is still a beautiful world.Be cheerful.Strive to be happy.
quotes.author: Max Ehrmann,  Desiderata: A Poem for a Way of Life

quotes.quote: We need to move into a culture of peace. What I hope to promote is the idea that we all need each other and that the greatest happiness in life is not how much we have but how much we give. That's a wealth that's priceless. You can't buy compassion.
quotes.author: Herbie Hancock

quotes.quote: After all, what is happiness? Love, they tell me. But love doesn't bring and never has brought happiness. On the contrary, it's a constant state of anxiety, a battlefield; it's sleepless nights, asking ourselves all the time if we're doing the right thing. Real love is composed of ecstasy and agony.
quotes.author: Paulo Coelho,  The Witch Of Portobello

quotes.quote: Happiness is not always through success. Equally, the constant pursuit of success is sure unhappiness. But we have to find the balance. My own thoughts are that parenting is very personal. And we all feel enormous insecurity about parenting. What are they going to think of us 20 years down the line?
quotes.author: Amy Chua

quotes.quote: I have no faith in human perfectibility. I think that human exertion will have no appreciable effect upon humanity. Man is now only more active - not more happy - nor more wise, than he was 6000 years ago.
quotes.author: Edgar Allan Poe

quotes.quote: I, not events, have the power to make me happy or unhappy today. I can choose which it shall be. Yesterday is dead, tomorrow hasn't arrived yet. I have just one day, today, and I'm going to be happy in it.
quotes.author: Groucho Marx,  The Essential Groucho: Writings For By And About Groucho Marx

quotes.quote: Sadness gives depth. Happiness gives height. Sadness gives roots. Happiness gives branches. Happiness is like a tree going into the sky, and sadness is like the roots going down into the womb of the earth. Both are needed, and the higher a tree goes, the deeper it goes, simultaneously. The bigger the tree, the bigger will be its roots. In fact, it is always in proportion. That's its balance.
quotes.author: Osho,  Everyday Osho: 365 Daily Meditations for the Here and Now

quotes.quote: Children are happy because they don't have a file in their minds called "All the Things That Could Go Wrong.
quotes.author: Marianne Williamson

quotes.quote: I will not try to convince you to love me, to respect me, to commit to me. I deserve better than that; I AM BETTER THAN THAT...Goodbye.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: Rejoicing in our joy, not suffering over our suffering, makes someone a friend.
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quotes.quote: Happiness is not a goal...it's a by-product of a life well lived.
quotes.author: Eleanor Roosevelt

quotes.quote: Joy is the infallible sign of the presence of God.
quotes.author: Pierre Teilhard de Chardin

quotes.quote: The greater part of our happiness or misery depends upon our dispositions, and not upon our circumstances.
quotes.author: Martha Washington

quotes.quote: Don't sacrifice yourself too much, because if you sacrifice too much there's nothing else you can give and nobody will care for you.
quotes.author: Karl Lagerfeld

quotes.quote: She is free in her wildness, she is a wanderess, a drop of free water. She knows nothing of borders and cares nothing for rules or customs. 'Time' for her isn't something to fight against. Her life flows clean, with passion, like fresh water.
quotes.author: Roman Payne

quotes.quote: That's the difference between me and the rest of the world! Happiness isn't good enough for me! I demand euphoria!
quotes.author: Bill Watterson,  Weirdos From Another Planet: Calvin & Hobbes Series: Book Six: A Calvin and Hobbes Collection

quotes.quote: Laughter is poison to fear.
quotes.author: George R.R. Martin,  A Game of Thrones

quotes.quote: The power of finding beauty in the humblest things makes home happy and life lovely.
quotes.author: Louisa May Alcott

quotes.quote: I am a happy camper so I guess I'm doing something right. Happiness is like a butterfly; the more you chase it, the more it will elude you, but if you turn your attention to other things, it will come and sit softly on your shoulder.
quotes.author: Henry David Thoreau

quotes.quote: I heard a definition once: Happiness is health and a short memory! I wish I'd invented it, because it is very true.
quotes.author: Audrey Hepburn

quotes.quote: Happiness is not a possession to be prized, it is a quality of thought, a state of mind.
quotes.author: Daphne du Maurier,  Rebecca

quotes.quote: I don't think that there are any limits to how excellent we could make life seem.
quotes.author: Jonathan Safran Foer,  Everything Is Illuminated

quotes.quote: I am very happyBecause I have conquered myselfAnd not the world.I am very happyBecause I have loved the worldAnd not myself.
quotes.author: Sri Chinmoy

quotes.quote: Some of you say, 'Joy is greater than sorrow,' and others say, 'Nay, sorrow is the greater.'But I say unto you, they are inseparable.Together they come, and when one sits alone with you at your board, remember that the other is asleep upon your bed.
quotes.author: Kahlil Gibran,  The Prophet

quotes.quote: I have a million things to talk to you about. All I want in this world is you. I want to see you and talk. I want the two of us to begin everything from the beginning.
quotes.author: Haruki Murakami,  Norwegian Wood

quotes.quote: And I can't be running back and fourth forever between grief and high delight.
quotes.author: J.D. Salinger,  Franny and Zooey

quotes.quote: We don't even ask happiness, just a little less pain.
quotes.author: Charles Bukowski

quotes.quote: A thing of beauty is a joy forever.
quotes.author: John Keats,  Endymion: A Poetic Romance

quotes.quote: Everyone wants to live on top of the mountain, but all the happiness and growth occurs while you're climbing it.
quotes.author: Andy Rooney

quotes.quote: Tears of joy are like the summer rain drops pierced by sunbeams.
quotes.author: Hosea Ballou

quotes.quote: Action may not always bring happiness, but there is no happiness without action.
quotes.author: William James

quotes.quote: Happiness is a butterfly, which when pursued, is always just beyond your grasp, but which, if you will sit down quietly, may alight upon you.
quotes.author: Nathaniel Hawthorne

quotes.quote: I've always thought people would find a lot more pleasure in their routines if they burst into song at significant moments.
quotes.author: John Barrowman

quotes.quote: The sense of unhappiness is so much easier to convey than that of happiness. In misery we seem aware of our own existence, even though it may be in the form of a monstrous egotism: this pain of mine is individual, this nerve that winces belongs to me and to no other. But happiness annihilates us: we lose our identity.
quotes.author: Graham Greene,  The End of the Affair

quotes.quote: What can I do with my happiness? How can I keep it, conceal it, bury it where I may never lose it? I want to kneel as it falls over me like rain, gather it up with lace and silk, and press it over myself again.
quotes.author: AnaÃ¯s Nin,  Henry & June

quotes.quote: Letting go gives us freedom, and freedom is the only condition for happiness. If, in our heart, we still cling to anything - anger, anxiety, or possessions - we cannot be free.
quotes.author: Hanh Nhat Thich,  The Heart of the Buddha's Teaching: Transforming Suffering into Peace, Joy, and Liberation

quotes.quote: I'm a kind of paranoiac in reverse. I suspect people of plotting to make me happy.
quotes.author: J.D. Salinger,  Raise High the Roof Beam, Carpenters & Seymour: An Introduction

quotes.quote: If only we'd stop trying to be happy, we could have a pretty good time.
quotes.author: Edith Wharton

quotes.quote: Life is not a PG feel-good movie. Real life often ends badly. Literature tries to document this reality, while showing us it is still possible for us to endure nobly.
quotes.author: Matthew Quick,  The Silver Linings Playbook

quotes.quote: Well, that's an evil smile...
quotes.author: James Patterson,  The Angel Experiment

quotes.quote: Happiness is a risk. If you're not a little scared, then you're not doing it right.
quotes.author: Sarah Addison Allen,  The Peach Keeper

quotes.quote: Happiness consists in frequent repetition of pleasure
quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer

quotes.quote: I find the best way to love someone is not to change them, but instead, help them reveal the greatest version of themselves.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: If I can see pain in your eyes then share with me your tears. If I can see joy in your eyes then share with me your smile.
quotes.author: Santosh Kalwar

quotes.quote: The pain I feel now is the happiness I had before. That's the deal.
quotes.author: C.S. Lewis

quotes.quote: Our greatest happiness does not depend on the condition of life in which chance has placed us, but is always the result of a good conscience, good health, occupation, and freedom in all just pursuits.
quotes.author: Thomas Jefferson

quotes.quote: This life is yours. Take the power to choose what you want to do and do it well. Take the power to love what you want in life and love it honestly. quotes.author: Susan Polis Schutz

quotes.quote: No one should ever ask themselves that: why am I unhappy? The question carries within it the virus that will destroy everything. If we ask that question, it means we want to find out what makes us happy. If what makes us happy is different from what we have now, then we must either change once and for all or stay as we are, feeling even more unhappy.
quotes.author: Paulo Coelho,  The Zahir

quotes.quote: Even if things don't unfold the way you expected, don't be disheartened or give up. One who continues to advance will win in the end.
quotes.author: Daisaku Ikeda

quotes.quote: I don't know what's worse: to not know what you are and be happy, or to become what you've always wanted to be, and feel alone.
quotes.author: Daniel Keyes,  Flowers for Algernon

quotes.quote: If you want others to be happy, practice compassion. If you want to be happy, practice compassion.
quotes.author: Dalai Lama XIV,  The Art of Happiness

quotes.quote: I had rather hear my dog bark at a crow, than a man swear he loves me.
quotes.author: William Shakespeare,  Much Ado About Nothing

quotes.quote: We all live with the objective of being happy; our lives are all different and yet the same.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: The problem with people is they forget that most of the time it's the small things that count.
quotes.author: Jennifer Niven,  All the Bright Places

quotes.quote: Happiness is not something you postpone for the future; it is something you design for the present.
quotes.author: Jim Rohn

quotes.quote: My happiness is not the means to any end. It is the end. It is its own goal. It is its own purpose.
quotes.author: Ayn Rand,  Anthem

quotes.quote: All who joy would winMust share it -- Happiness was born a twin.
quotes.author: George Gordon Byron,  Don Juan

quotes.quote: Happiness. It was the place where passion, with all its dazzle and drumbeat, met something softer: homecoming and safety and pure sunbeam comfort. It was all those things, intertwined with the heat and the thrill, and it was as bright within her as a swallowed star.
quotes.author: Laini Taylor,  Daughter of Smoke & Bone

quotes.quote: Be believing, be happy, don't get discouraged. Things will work out.
quotes.author: Gordon B. Hinckley

quotes.quote: I really think that technology has the greatest potential to accelerate happiness of most things in the world. The companies that will ultimately do well are the companies that chase happiness. If you find a way to help people find love, or health or friendship, the dollar will chase that.
quotes.author: Ashton Kutcher

quotes.quote: It takes three to make love, not two: you, your spouse, and God. Without God people only succeed in bringing out the worst in one another. Lovers who have nothing else to do but love each other soon find there is nothing else. Without a central loyalty life is unfinished.
quotes.author: Fulton J. Sheen,  Seven Words of Jesus and Mary: Lessons from Cana and Calvary

quotes.quote: There is no happiness like that of being loved by your fellow creatures, and feeling that your presence is an addition to their comfort.
quotes.author: Charlotte BrontÃ«,  Jane Eyre

quotes.quote: You cannot be with someone just because you don't want to hurt him. You have your own happiness to think about.
quotes.author: Melissa de la Cruz,  The Van Alen Legacy

quotes.quote: If we can just let go and trust that things will work out they way they're supposed to, without trying to control the outcome, then we can begin to enjoy the moment more fully. The joy of the freedom it brings becomes more pleasurable than the experience itself.
quotes.author: Goldie Hawn

quotes.quote: those who do not know how to see the precious things in life will never be happy.
quotes.author: Alex Flinn,  Beastly

quotes.quote: To dream by night is to escape your life. To dream by day is to make it happen.
quotes.author: Stephen Richards

quotes.quote: Dare to love yourselfas if you were a rainbowwith gold at both ends.
quotes.author: Aberjhani,  Journey through the Power of the Rainbow: Quotations from a Life Made Out of Poetry

quotes.quote: You must give everything to make your life as beautiful as the dreams that dance in your imagination.
quotes.author: Roman Payne

quotes.quote: Many people think excitement is happiness.... But when you are excited you are not peaceful. True happiness is based on peace.
quotes.author: Hanh Nhat Thich,  The Art of Power

quotes.quote: Too often we underestimate the power of a touch, a smile, a kind word, alistening ear, an honest compliment, or the smallest act of caring, allof which have the potential to turn a life around.
quotes.author: Leo Buscaglia

quotes.quote: Wealth consists not in having great possessions, but in having few wants.
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.quote: Oh, Lizzy! do anything rather than marry without affection.
quotes.author: Jane Austen,  Pride and Prejudice

quotes.quote: All I ask is one thing, and I'm asking this particularly of young people: please don't be cynical. I hate cynicism, for the record, it's my least favorite quality and it doesn't lead anywhere. Nobody in life gets exactly what they thought they were going to get. But if you work really hard and you're kind, amazing things will happen.
quotes.author: Conan O'Brien

quotes.quote: Happiness. Simple as a glass of chocolate or tortuous as the heart. Bitter. Sweet. Alive.
quotes.author: Joanne Harris,  Chocolat

quotes.quote: Happy girls are the prettiest
quotes.author: Audrey Hepburn

quotes.quote: There you go...let it all slide out. Unhappiness can't stick in a person's soul when it's slick with tears.
quotes.author: Shannon Hale,  Princess Academy

quotes.quote: I am intrigued by the smile upon your face, and the sadness within your eyes
quotes.author: Jeremy Aldana

quotes.quote: It's a helluva start, being able to recognize what makes you happy.
quotes.author: Lucille Ball

quotes.quote: Very little is needed to make a happy life; it is all within yourself in your way of thinking.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius,  Meditations

quotes.quote: It is sometimes easier to be happy if you don't know everything.
quotes.author: Alexander McCall Smith,  Morality for Beautiful Girls

quotes.quote: You can't be brave if you've only had wonderful things happen to you.
quotes.author: Mary Tyler Moore

quotes.quote: When you feel someone else's pain and joy as powerfully as if it were your own, then you know you really loved them.
quotes.author: Ann Brashares,  Girls In Pants: The Third Summer of the Sisterhood

quotes.quote: Don't walk in front of me, I may not follow. Don't walk behind me, I may not lead. There is only one happiness in life, to love and be loved.
quotes.author: George Sand

quotes.quote: Success is getting what you want..Happiness is wanting what you get.
quotes.author: Dale Carnegie

quotes.quote: Sometimes you break your heart in the right way, if you know what I mean.
quotes.author: Gregory David Roberts,  Shantaram

quotes.quote: Woman is not made to be the admiration of all, but the happiness of one.
quotes.author: Edmund Burke

quotes.quote: Color is my day-long obsession, joy and torment.
quotes.author: Claude Monet

quotes.quote: It does not matter how long you are spending on the earth, how much money you have gathered or how much attention you have received. It is the amount of positive vibration you have radiated in life that matters,
quotes.author: Amit Ray,  Meditation: Insights and Inspirations

quotes.quote: They've got no idea what happiness is, they don't know that without this love there is no happiness or unhappiness for us--there is no life.
quotes.author: Leo Tolstoy,  Anna Karenina

quotes.quote: Happiness is a perfume you cannot pour on others without getting some on yourself.
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quotes.quote: And therein lies the whole of man's plight. Human time does not turn in a circle; it runs ahead in a straight line. That is why man cannot be happy: happiness is the longing for repetition.
quotes.author: Milan Kundera,  The Unbearable Lightness of Being

quotes.quote: Love is too precious to be ashamed of.
quotes.author: Laurell K. Hamilton,  A Stroke of Midnight

quotes.quote: Plant seeds of happiness, hope, success, and love; it will all come back to you in abundance. This is the law of nature.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: My past has not defined me, destroyed me, deterred me, or defeated me; it has only strengthened me.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: right in this moment, I canÂ´t even remember what unhappy feels like.
quotes.author: Maggie Stiefvater,  Shiver

quotes.quote: How easy to be amiable in the midst of happiness and success.
quotes.author: William Ellery Channing

quotes.quote: The trouble is that we have a bad habit, encouraged by pedants and sophisticates, of considering happiness as something rather stupid. Only pain is intellectual, only evil interesting. This is the treason of the artist; a refusal to admit the banality of evil and the terrible boredom of pain.
quotes.author: Ursula K. Le Guin,  The Ones Who Walk Away from Omelas

quotes.quote: I don't know what good it is to know so much and be smart as whips and all if it doesn't make you happy.
quotes.author: J.D. Salinger,  Franny and Zooey

quotes.quote: He had a new girl, and I told him she looked like Marilyn Monroe. He smiled because he thought I meant she was beautiful, and I smiled because I meant she looked like a corpse.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  The Titanic would never have sunk if it were made out of a sink.

quotes.quote: And I didn't choose it, Kat. I chose you.
quotes.author: Ally Carter,  Heist Society

quotes.quote: Just because you are happy it does not mean that the day is perfect but that you have looked beyond its imperfections
quotes.author: Bob Marley

quotes.quote: Let us dance in the sun, wearing wild flowers in our hair...
quotes.author: Susan Polis Schutz

quotes.quote: Friendship is a strong and habitual inclination in two persons to promote the good and happiness of one another.
quotes.author: Eustace Budgell

quotes.quote: Feathers filled the small room. Our laughter kept the feathers in the air. I thought about birds. Could they fly is there wasn't someone, somewhere, laughing?
quotes.author: Jonathan Safran Foer,  Extremely Loud and Incredibly Close

quotes.quote: It only takes a split second to smile and forget, yet to someone that needed it, it can last a lifetime.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: She had never imagined she had the power to make someone else so happy. And not a magical power, either--a purely human one.
quotes.author: Cassandra Clare,  Clockwork Prince

quotes.quote: We buy things we don't need with money we don't have to impress people we don't like.
quotes.author: Dave Ramsey,  The Total Money Makeover: A Proven Plan for Financial Fitness

quotes.quote: Memory is the happiness of being alone.
quotes.author: Lois Lowry,  Anastasia Krupnik

quotes.quote: You're insane!"she shouted."Pretty cool, huh?""No!"Tally yelled. "Why didn't you tell me it was broken?"Shay shrugged. "More fun that way?""More fun?"Her heart beating fast,her vision strangely clear. She was full of anger and relief and...joy."Well, kind of. But you suck!
quotes.author: Scott Westerfeld,  Uglies

quotes.quote: The most enjoyable book in the world is the phone book, because think of all the sex that went into creating the content.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  99 Cents For Some Nonsense

quotes.quote: Obscurity and a competence--that is the life that is best worth living.
quotes.author: Mark Twain,  Notebook

quotes.quote: Only the development of compassion and understanding for others can bring us the tranquility and happiness we all seek.
quotes.author: Dalai Lama XIV

quotes.quote: True happiness arises, in the first place, from the enjoyment of one's self, and in the next, from the friendship and conversation of a few select companions.
quotes.author: Joseph Addison

quotes.quote: Love is that condition in which the happiness of another person is essential to your own... Jealousy is a disease, love is a healthy condition. The immature mind often mistakes one for the other, or assumes that the greater the love, the greater the jealousy.
quotes.author: Robert A. Heinlein

quotes.quote: Art is unquestionably one of the purest and highest elements in human happiness. It trains the mind through the eye, and the eye through the mind. As the sun colors flowers, so does art color life.
quotes.author: John Lubbock,  The Pleasures of Life

quotes.quote: The only time you fail is when you fall down and stay down.
quotes.author: Stephen Richards,  Cosmic Ordering: You can be successful

quotes.quote: Humanity does not ask us to be happy. It merely asks us to be brilliant on its behalf.
quotes.author: Orson Scott Card,  Ender's Game

quotes.quote: It's inspirational to see someone who is dying smile.
quotes.author: Arlen Specter

quotes.quote: Write it on your heart you are the most beautiful soul of the Universe. Realize it, honor it and celebrate the life.
quotes.author: Amit Ray,  Nonviolence: The Transforming Power

quotes.quote: Did you know it takes more muscles to frown than it does to smile? I know, because yesterday was in a bad mood, and I guess I must have frowned too much because this morning I woke up with a torn groin muscle.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This is the story my great-grandfather told my father, who then told my grandfather, who then told me about how The Mythical Mr. Boo, Charles Manseur Fizzlebush Grissham III, better known as Mr. Fizzlebush, and Orafoura are all in fact me...

quotes.quote: Stop pointing fingers and placing blame on others. Your life can only change to the degree that you accept responsibility for it.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: A free people ought not only to be armed and disciplined, but they should have sufficient arms and ammunition to maintain a status of independence from any who might attempt to abuse them, which would include their own government
quotes.author: Spurious quote attributed to George Washington but never said by him .

quotes.quote: It seemed like this day could go in so many directions, like a spiderweb shooting out toward endless possibilities. Whenever you made a choice, especially one you'd been resisting, it always affected everything else, some in big ways, like a tremor beneath your feet, others in so tiny a shift you hardly noticed a change at all. But it was happening.
quotes.author: Sarah Dessen

quotes.quote: Today, many will choose to live free of conditions and rules governing their own happiness. Why not you? Do not let another day go by where your dedication to other people's opinions is greater than your dedication to your own emotions! Today's a new day!
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: Be Sure To Notice When You're Happy
quotes.author: Brenda Farrar-ejemai

quotes.quote: Suffering is due to our disconnection with the inner soul. Meditation is establishing that connection.
quotes.author: Amit Ray,  Meditation: Insights and Inspirations

quotes.quote: After all, is not a real Hell better than a manufactured Heaven?
quotes.author: E.M. Forster,  Maurice

quotes.quote: A withered maple leaf has left its branch and is falling to the ground; its movements resemble those of a butterfly in flight. Isn't it strange? The saddest and deadest of things is yet so like the gayest and most vital of creatures?

quotes.quote: Live Today! Do not allow your spirit to be softened of your happiness to be limited by a day you cannot have back or a day that does not yet exist.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: Stop waiting for the perfect day or the perfect moment... Take THIS day, THIS moment and lead it to perfection.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: What is given to you is what is needed; what you want, requires giving up what you don't need.
quotes.author: George Alexiou

quotes.quote: too much happiness always overflowed into tears of sorrow.
quotes.author: Amy Tan,  The Hundred Secret Senses

quotes.quote: Cheerfulness and contentment are great beautifiers.
quotes.author: Jennifer E. Smith,  The Statistical Probability of Love at First Sight

quotes.quote: Maybe if we stopped trying to achieve movie standards of greatness, we'd be happy with what we have.
quotes.author: Amber L. Johnson,  Puddle Jumping

quotes.quote: If you think you can then you can.
quotes.author: Stephen Richards

quotes.quote: It is not the possession of truth, but the success which attends the seeking after it, that enriches the seeker and brings happiness to him.
quotes.author: Max Planck,  Where is Science Going?

quotes.quote: The secret of a happy life is respect. Respect for yourself and respect for others.
quotes.author: Ayad Akhtar,  American Dervish

quotes.quote: and our few good times will be rare because we have the critical senseand are not easy to fool with laughter
quotes.author: Charles Bukowski

quotes.author: Horace

quotes.quote: There are two types of seeds in the mind: those that create anger, fear, frustration, jealousy, hatred and those that create love, compassion, equanimity and joy. Spirituality is germination and sprouting of the second group and transforming the first group.
quotes.author: Amit Ray

quotes.quote: Happiness is not only a hope, but also in some strange manner a memory ... we are all kings in exile.
quotes.author: G.K. Chesterton,  The Thing

quotes.quote: Who's happy? Happy is just what people think they are when they can't find anything to bitch about.
quotes.author: Rasmenia Massoud,  Human Detritus

quotes.quote: LEONATOWell, niece, I hope to see you one day fitted with a husband.BEATRICENot till God make men of some other metal than earth.
