quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

quotes.quote: You have to be willing to get happy about nothing.
quotes.author: Andy Warhol

quotes.quote: How aware are we of our own inner life, our spirituality-something so intangible yet so priceless? How much effort do we make to perceive that which is not obvious, which can neither be seen nor heard? I believe the exploration and enrichment of the human spirit is what determines our very humanity. Such enrichment provides an inner compass that can lead civilizations to greatness.
quotes.author: Daisaku Ikeda

quotes.quote: Concentration attracts luck factor.
quotes.author: Amit Ray,  Yoga and Vipassana: An Integrated Life Style

quotes.quote: Everyone chases after happiness, not noticing that happiness is at their heels.
quotes.author: Bertolt Brecht

quotes.quote: Because I was more often happy for other people, I got to spend more time being happy. And as I saw more light in everybody else, I seemed to have more myself. (250)
quotes.author: Victoria Moran,  Lit From Within: Tending Your Soul For Lifelong Beauty

quotes.quote: Happiness simply cannot be relied upon as a measure of success.
quotes.author: John C. Maxwell,  Your Road Map for Success: You Can Get There from Here

quotes.quote: The devil's happy when the critics run you off.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Venus in Arms

quotes.quote: Happiness is a nothingness without completeness.
quotes.author: Hlovate,  Contengan Jalanan

quotes.quote: The universe doesn't give you what you want in your mind; it gives you what you demand with your actions.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: I am the happiest man alive. I have that in me that can convert poverty to riches, adversity to prosperity, and I am more invulnerable than Archilles; Fortune hath not one place to hit me.
quotes.author: Thomas Browne

quotes.quote: Each new friend gives rise to the possibility of anything!
quotes.author: Stephen Richards

quotes.quote: The First Splendid Truth: To be happy, I need to think about feeling good, feeling bad, and feeling right, in an atmosphere of growth.
quotes.author: Gretchen Rubin,  The Happiness Project: Or Why I Spent a Year Trying to Sing in the Morning, Clean My Closets, Fight Right, Read Aristotle, and Generally Have More Fun

quotes.quote: If you could have one wish, what would it be? We all have hopes and dreams that we do almost anything to make real. And if we get lucky, and our wish is granted, maybe that's what we call happiness.
quotes.author: I Am An Idiot Spammer

quotes.quote: Happiness in this world, when it comes, comes incidentally. Make it the object of pursuit, and it leads us a wild-goose chase, and is never attained. Follow some other object, and very possibly we may find that we have caught happiness without dreaming of it.
quotes.author: Nathaniel Hawthorne

quotes.quote: One could be happy not only without love, but despite it.
quotes.author: Gabriel GarcÃ­Â­a MÃ¡rquez,  Love in the Time of Cholera

quotes.quote: I sit quietly and think about my mom. It's funny how memory erodes, If all I had to work from were my childhood memories, my knowledge of my mother would be faded and soft, with a few sharp memories standing out.
quotes.author: Audrey Niffenegger,  The Time Traveler's Wife

quotes.quote: Let today be the day you finally release yourself from the imprisonment of past grudges and anger. Simplify your life. Let go of the poisonous past and live the abundantly beautiful present... today.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: Pippin glanced in some wonder at the face now close beside his own, for the sound of that laugh had been gay and merry. Yet in the wizard's face he saw at first only lines of care and sorrow; though as he looked more intently he perceived that under all there was a great joy: a fountain of mirth enough to set a kingdom laughing, were it to gush forth.
quotes.author: J.R.R. Tolkien,  The Lord of the Rings

quotes.quote: Actually, I jade very quickly. Once is usually enough. Either once only, or every day. If you do something once it's exciting, and if you do it every day it's exciting. But if you do it, say, twice or just almost every day, it's not good any more.
quotes.author: Andy Warhol

quotes.quote: The value of a moment is immeasurable. The power of just ONE moment can propel you to success and happiness or chain you to failure and misery.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: You need to figure out what you want, Josh. If that means you need to swim against the tide to get it, at least youre aiming for something that could make you very happy.
quotes.author: Jay Asher,  The Future of Us

quotes.quote: Be patient. Your skin took a while to deteriorate. Give it some time to reflect a calmer inner state. As one of my friends states on his Facebook profile: "The true Losers in Life, are not those who Try and Fail, but those who Fail to Try.
quotes.author: Jess C. Scott,  Clear: A Guide to Treating Acne Naturally

quotes.quote: A woman's happiness is in throwing everything away to live for love.
quotes.author: Ai Yazawa,  Paradise Kiss, Vol. 5

quotes.quote: Remember, happiness doesn't depend upon who you are or what you have; it depends solely upon what you think. So start each day by thinking of all the things you have to be thankful for. Your future will depend very largely on the thoughts you think today. So think thoughts of hope and confidence and love and success.
quotes.author: Dale Carnegie

quotes.quote: Flowers always make people better, happier, and more helpful; they are sunshine, food and medicine to the mind.
quotes.author: Luther Burbank

quotes.quote: The dead don't desire revenge, but the happiness of the livng. To dirty your small hands would bring joy to no one.-Kenshin to Eiji
quotes.author: Nobuhiro Watsuki

quotes.quote: May those who follow their fate be granted happiness; may those who defy it be granted glory
quotes.author: Mizuo Shinonome,  Princess Tu Tu Volume 1

quotes.quote: To be happy you must have taken the measure of your powers, tasted the fruits of your passion, and learned your place in the world.
quotes.author: George Santayana

quotes.quote: The pretty ones are usually unhappy. They expect everyone to be enamored of their beauty. How can a person be content when their happiness lies in someone else's hands, ready to be crushed at any moment? Ordinary-looking people are far superior, because they are forced to actually work hard to achieve their goals, instead of expecting people to fall all over themselves to help them.
quotes.author: J. Cornell Michel,  Jordan's Brains: A Zombie Evolution

quotes.quote: The key to knowing joy is being easily pleased.
quotes.author: Mark Nepo

quotes.quote: The truly revolutionary promise of our nation's founding document is the freedom to pursue happiness-with-a-capital-H.
quotes.author: Dan Savage,  Skipping Towards Gomorrah

quotes.quote: No one is to blame because there is no one other than you. Nothing is to disrespect because there is nothing other than you.
quotes.author: Amit Ray

quotes.quote: Most people think, when they're young, that they're going to the top of their chosen world, and that the climb up is only a formality. Without that faith, I suppose, they might never start. Somewhere on the way they lift their eyes to the summit and know they aren't going to reach it; and happiness then is looking down and enjoying the view they've got, not envying the one they haven't.
quotes.author: Dick Francis,  Reflex

quotes.quote: When we give up the chase, we give up our wishing.
quotes.author: Stephen Richards

quotes.quote: Stop waiting for the right person to come into your life. Be the right person to come to someone's life
quotes.author: Leo Babauta

quotes.quote: The happiness you feel is in direct proportion to the love you give.
quotes.author: Oprah Winfrey

quotes.quote: The pleasure of criticizing takes away from us the pleasure of being moved by some very fine things.
quotes.author: Jean de La BruyÃ¨re

quotes.quote: Be happy for no reason, like a child. If you are happy for a reason, you're in trouble, because that reason can be taken from you.
quotes.author: Deepak Chopra

quotes.quote: Happiness lies for those who cry, those who hurt, those who have searched, and those who have tried for only they can appreciate the importance of people who have touched their lives.
quotes.author: Victor Hugo

quotes.quote: You are beautiful. Your beauty, just like your capacity for life, happiness, and success, is immeasurable.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: The only horrible thing in the world is ennui.
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde,  The Picture of Dorian Gray

quotes.quote: An important decision I made was to resist playing the Blame Game. The day I realized that I am in charge of how I will approach problems in my life, that things will turn out better or worse because of me and nobody else, that was the day I knew I would be a happier and healthier person. And that was the day I knew I could truly build a life that matters.
quotes.author: Steve Goodier

quotes.quote: An ordinary man can surround himself with two thousand books and thenceforward have at least one place in the world in which it is always possible to be happy.
quotes.author: Augustine Birrell

quotes.quote: You are an ocean in a drop of dew,all the universes in a thin sack of blood.What are these pleasures then,these joys, these worldsthat you keep reaching for,hoping they will make you more alive?
quotes.author: Rumi

quotes.quote: The business of being happy requires making a conscious choice. People think being happy will just happen to them someday, if only they do this or that right. But it doesn't - you have to choose it. You choose happiness, you don't wait for it to choose you.
quotes.author: Bethenny Frankel,  A Place of Yes: 10 Rules for Getting Everything You Want Out of Life

quotes.quote: You must remember this feeling, Jon.The feeling of being happy. It doesn't happen often but when it does, you must grab it with both hands and hold it close. Let it overwhelm you. Don'tover analyse any emotion. But remember it. Always remember it.
quotes.author: pleasefindthis,  Intentional Dissonance

quotes.quote: What would it be like to look in the mirror and actually accept what you see? Not loathe the reflection, or despise it, or be resigned to it? But to like it?
quotes.author: Justina Chen,  North of Beautiful

quotes.quote: I bought you a gift. It's something I've always wanted, but I'm not quite sure you'll like it. So if you don't want it just tell me and I'll be happy to keep it. After all, I'm only interested in making you happy.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  At even one penny, this book would be overpriced. In fact, free is too expensive, because you'd still waste time by reading it.

quotes.quote: Don't put off happiness you can have today. Tomorrow is a hope, not a promise
quotes.author: Debra Anastasia

quotes.quote: If you do not have persistence then no amount of education, talent or genius can make up for it.
quotes.author: Stephen Richards

quotes.quote: It's only natural to feel lonely after the enjoyable moments pass. But as you experience new joys those feelings of sorrow will start to fade.
quotes.author: Mizu Sahara

quotes.quote: Life is so short. The only person you hurt when you stay angry or hold grudges is you. Forgive everyone, including yourself.
quotes.author: Tom Giaquinto

quotes.quote: and we laugh and laugh andall I know isat this moment I feel likeI can do anything I wantand be anyone I wantand go anywhere on the globeand still call it home
quotes.author: Kirsten Smith,  The Geography of Girlhood

quotes.quote: What would a narrative of happiness be like? All that can be described is what prepares it, and then what destroys it.
quotes.author: AndrÃ© Gide,  The Immoralist

quotes.quote: Happiness doesn't always come from a pursuit. Sometimes it comes when we least expect it.
quotes.author: Dalai Lama XIV

quotes.quote: And hard times are good in their own way, too. Because the only way you can achieve true happiness is if you experience true sadness as well. It's all about light and shade. Balance.
quotes.author: Gabrielle Williams,  Beatle Meets Destiny

quotes.quote: when he smiles it's as if you'd just told him the first joke on earth.
quotes.author: Mitch Albom,  Tuesdays with Morrie

quotes.quote: Everywhere we shine death and life burn into something new...
quotes.author: Aberjhani,  Elemental: The Power of Illuminated Love

quotes.quote: [Happiness is] a ghost, it's a shadow. You can't really chase it. It's a by-product, a very pleasant side effect to a life lived well.
quotes.author: Eric Weiner

quotes.quote: We have everything we need to be happy, but we aren't happy. Something's missing.
quotes.author: Ray Bradbury

quotes.quote: To risk life to save a smile on a face of a woman or a child is the secret of chivalry.
quotes.author: Dejan Stojanovic

quotes.quote: ...The world is full of happy people but no one ever hears of them. You have to fight and make a scandal to get in the papers. No one knows about all the happy people...
quotes.author: Gene Stratton-Porter,  A Girl of the Limberlost

quotes.quote: Don't live to be judged for what you haven't done. Live to be judged for what you have done.
quotes.author: Stephen Richards

quotes.quote: The crowning fortune of a man is to be born to some pursuit which finds him employment and happiness, whether it be to make baskets, or broadswords, or canals, or statues, or songs.
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quotes.quote: Vipassana meditation is an ongoing creative purification process. Observation of the moment-to-moment experience cleanses the mental layers, one after another.
quotes.author: Amit Ray,  Yoga and Vipassana: An Integrated Life Style

quotes.quote: A week feels like a year when you're seventeen and in love. A twenty minute drive might as well be an ocean. But we were together again and the whole world was rejoicing, even the gravel crunched melodiously under our feet as we danced onward through the night.
quotes.author: Chloe Rattray,  SacrÃ© Noir

quotes.quote: Free yourself from the complexities of your life! A life of simplicity and happiness awaits you.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: Sometimes when you're young, you have moments of such happiness, you think you're living on someplace magical, like Atlantis must have been. Then we grow up and our hearts break into two.
quotes.author: Stephen King,  Hearts in Atlantis

quotes.quote: They think I'm simpleminded because I seem to be happy. Why shouldn't I be happy? I have everything I ever wanted and more. Maybe I am simpleminded. Maybe that's the key: simple.
quotes.author: Dolly Parton,  Dolly: My Life and Other Unfinished Business

quotes.quote: If you write it down, you can make it happen.
quotes.author: Staness Jonekos

quotes.quote: Call no man happy until he is dead.
quotes.author: Solon

quotes.quote: To buy a cake... to howl at the moon... to know true happiness... I am happy.
quotes.author: C. JoyBell C.

quotes.quote: I do want more. I am not content with being happy. I was not made for it. It is not my destiny. My destiny is the opposite.
quotes.author: Hermann Hesse,  Steppenwolf

quotes.quote: Perhaps some people really are born unhappy. I surely hope not. Speaking for my sister and myself: We were born with the capacity and determination to be utterly happy all the time. Perhaps even in this we were freaks. Hi ho.
quotes.author: Kurt Vonnegut,  Slapstick or Lonesome No More!

quotes.quote: You don't have to be part of a couple to be happy, you know.
quotes.author: Phyllis Reynolds Naylor,  Alice Alone

quotes.quote: We can't be so desperate for love that we forget where we can always find it; within.
quotes.author: Alexandra Elle

quotes.quote: Start with big dreams and make life worth living.
quotes.author: Stephen Richards

quotes.quote: No beating yourself up. That's not allowed. Be patient with yourself. It took you years to form the bad habits of thought that you no longer want. It will take a littletime to form new and better ones. But I promise you this: Even a slight move in this direction will bring you some peace. The more effort you apply to it, the faster you'll find your bliss, but you'll experience rewards immediately.
quotes.author: Holly Mosier

quotes.quote: The fact that I can plant a seed and it becomes a flower, share a bit of knowledge and it becomes another's, smile at someone and receive a smile in return, are to me continual spiritual exercises.
quotes.author: Leo Buscaglia

quotes.quote: I know a girl from whose body sunbeams rose to the clouds as if they'd fallen from the sun.Her laugh was like a bangle of bells. 'Your hair is wet,' I told her one day, 'Did you take a bath?' 'It is dew!' she laughed, 'I've been lying in the grass. All morning long, I lay here waiting for the dawn.
quotes.author: Roman Payne

quotes.quote: The one who would be constant in happiness must frequently change.
quotes.author: Anthony de Mello,  Awareness

quotes.quote: Stop lying to yourself. When we deny our own truth, we deny our own potential.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: It's impossible to be unhappy while wearing a poncho!
quotes.author: Noel Fielding

quotes.quote: Doing the tough things sets winners apart from losers.
quotes.author: Stephen Richards,  Cosmic Ordering: You can be successful

quotes.quote: God favors men and women who delight in being made worthy of happiness before the happiness itself.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

quotes.quote: I was happy anywhere I could see the ocean.
quotes.author: Ai Yazawa,  Nana, Vol. 18

quotes.quote: I believe there is a kind of happiness to be found in every thing in life, in all that is good and pleasing, as well as in that which is sad or poignant.
quotes.author: Syrie James,  The Lost Memoirs of Jane Austen

quotes.quote: Do we know our poor people? Do we know the poor in our house, in our family? Perhaps they are not hungry for a piece of bread. Perhaps our children, husband, wife, are not hungry, or naked, or dispossessed, but are you sure there is no one there who feels unwanted, deprived of affection?
quotes.author: Mother Teresa,  Heart of Joy

quotes.quote: She avoids deep thought like an empty restaurant, not out of stupidity, but a canny resolve to be happy.
quotes.author: Alex Shakar,  Luminarium

quotes.quote: God wanted to make heaven and the earth is that heaven. Nowhere in the universe there is so much love, life, beauty and peace. Enjoy your stay with the fellow beings.
quotes.author: Amit Ray,  Nonviolence: The Transforming Power

quotes.quote: How would your life be different if...You decided to give freely, love fully, and play feverously? Let today be the day...You free yourself from the conditioned rules that limit your happiness and dilute the beautiful life experience. Have fun. Give - Love - Play!
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  The Power of One

quotes.quote: I learned you pay for your happiness. That's why I don't expect to be happy all the time. I'd rather be surprised by one moment every so often to remind me that joy is possible, even if I have to pay for it later.
quotes.author: Esmeralda Santiago,  Conquistadora

quotes.quote: Work harder to appreciate your ordinary day.
quotes.author: Gretchen Rubin

quotes.quote: No man is happy who does not think himself so.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius,  Meditations

quotes.quote: I was entirely happy. Perhaps we feel like that when we die and become a part of something entire, whether it is sun and air. or goodness and knowledge. At any rate, that is happiness; to be dissolved into something complete and great. When it comes to one, it comes as naturally as sleep.
quotes.author: Willa Cather,  My Antonia

quotes.quote: A piece of happiness should never be taken as due.
quotes.author: Charlaine Harris,  Dead to the World

quotes.quote: Sometimes it just feels really really wonderful to be alive.
quotes.author: Doug Coupland

quotes.quote: The greatest joys in life are found not only in what we do and feel, but also in our quiet hopes and labors for others.
quotes.author: Bryant McGill,  Voice of Reason

quotes.quote: The most important reason for your 'no' is that you need your downtime so you won't behave like a jerk because you're depleted. And you don't want to battle an appetite spiked by the stress of overcommitment. But that's your secret; others don't need that information. So just smile, say no, thank you, and keep moving.
quotes.author: Holly Mosier

quotes.quote: All that you are is all around you.
quotes.author: Stephen Richards

quotes.quote: I wanted color. I wanted to soar with happiness even if it meant dealing with the weight of fear and guilt, too. I wanted to live.
quotes.author: Heather Anastasiu,  Glitch

quotes.quote: When we lose our spiritual child then that is when we have grown old.
quotes.author: Stephen Richards

quotes.quote: Dream your dream; and realize that you are more than just the dreamer, you are the point of origin for its reality.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: Every day has its great grief or its small anxiety. ... One cloud is dispelled, another forms. There is hardly one day in a hundred of real joy and bright sunshine.
quotes.author: Victor Hugo,  Les MisÃ©rables

quotes.quote: Why are those who are notoriously undisciplined and unmoral also most contemptuous of religion and morality? They are trying to solace their own unhappy lives by pulling the happy down to their own abysmal depths.
quotes.author: Fulton J. Sheen,  Seven Words of Jesus and Mary: Lessons from Cana and Calvary

quotes.quote: Happiness resides not in possessions, and not in gold, happiness dwells in the soul.
quotes.author: Democritus

quotes.quote: Stay away from conflictive, negative people that pull you down, because they contaminate your energy and impede your progress. Search for people who look at the world with optimism, that inspire you, make you happy and provide peace of mind.
quotes.author: Pablo

quotes.quote: The exaltation and happiness of any community, goes hand in hand with the knowledge possessed by the people, when applied to laudable ends; whereupon we can exclaim like the wise man; righteousness exalteth a nation; for righteousness embraces knowledge and knowledge is power.
quotes.author: Joseph Smith Jr.

quotes.quote: LEONATOWell, then, go you into hell?BEATRICENo, but to the gate; and there will the devil meet me, like an old cuckold, with horns on his head, and say 'Get you to heaven, Beatrice, get you to heaven; here's no place for you maids:' so deliver I up my apes, and away to Saint Peter for the heavens; he shows me where the bachelors sit, and there live we as merry as the day is long.
quotes.author: William Shakespeare,  Much Ado About Nothing

quotes.quote: Justice is the only worship.Love is the only priest.Ignorance is the only slavery.Happiness is the only good.The time to be happy is now,The place to be happy is here,The way to be happy is to make others so.Wisdom is the science of happiness.
quotes.author: Robert G. Ingersoll

quotes.quote: Clearly the secret of happiness...is a variation on the general principle of banging your head against a wall, and then stopping.
quotes.author: Stef Penney,  The Tenderness of Wolves

quotes.quote: Happiness must be grown in one's own garden.
quotes.author: Mary Engelbreit

quotes.quote: Anyone can smile on their best day. I like to meet a man who can smile on his WORST.
quotes.author: Lauren Graham,  Someday, Someday, Maybe

quotes.quote: We were all born equal, but where we are in life now is of our own making.
quotes.author: Stephen Richards

quotes.quote: Pleasure is the only thing one should live for, nothing ages like happiness.
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde

quotes.quote: I must die. Must I then die lamenting? I must be put in chains. Must I then also lament? I must go into exile. Does any man then hinder me from going with smiles and cheerfulness and contentment?
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.quote: Everyone knew that if you divided reality by expectation, you got a happiness quotient. But when you invert the equation - expectation divided by reality - you didn't get the opposite of happiness. What you got, Lewis realized, was hope.
quotes.author: Jodi Picoult,  Nineteen Minutes

quotes.quote: Associate with the noblest people you can find; read the best books; live with the mighty; but learn to be happy alone.
quotes.author: Saul Bellow,  Ravelstein

quotes.quote: People were always the limiters of happiness except for the very few that were as good as spring itself.
quotes.author: Ernest Hemingway,  A Moveable Feast: The Restored Edition

quotes.quote: When you know love then that is the time you forget hate.
quotes.author: Stephen Richards

quotes.quote: We all look for happiness, but without knowing where to find it: like drunkards who look for their house, knowing dimly that they have one
quotes.author: Voltaire

quotes.quote: Happiness comes in many forms -- in the company of good friends, in the feeling you get when you make someone else's dream come true, or in the promise of hope renewed. It's okay to let yourself be happy because you never know how fleeting that happiness might be.
quotes.author: Lucas Scott

quotes.quote: And when the hourglass has run out, the hourglass of temporality, when the noise of secular life has grown silent and its restless or ineffectual activism has come to an end, when everything around you is still, as it is in eternity, then eternity asks you and every individual in these millions and millions about only one thing: whether you have lived in despair or not.
quotes.author: SÃ¸ren Kierkegaard

quotes.quote: The glory of science is, that it is freeing the soul -- breaking the mental manacles -- getting the brain out of bondage -- giving courage to thought -- filling the world with mercy, justice, and joy.
quotes.author: Robert G. Ingersoll,  Humboldt From 'The Gods and Other Lectures'

quotes.quote: Suffering teaches joy.
quotes.author: Sonia Rumzi

quotes.quote: Man...who lives in three places - in the past, in the present, and in the future - can be unhappy if one of these three is worthless. Religion has even added a fourth - eternity.
quotes.author: Georg Christoph Lichtenberg

quotes.quote: Sometimes we assume that the new person in our life is better for us because they are totally different from the last person we dated. Only later do we see that we have chosen a different version of the same thing and they both leave us unsatisfied.
quotes.author: Kristen Crockett,  The Gift of Past Relationships

quotes.quote: In his or her own way, everyone I saw before me looked happy. Whether they were really happy or just looked it, I couldn't tell. But they did look happy on this pleasant early afternoon in late September, and because of that I felt a kind of loneliness new to me, as if I were the only one here who was not truly part of the scene.
quotes.author: Haruki Murakami,  Norwegian Wood

quotes.quote: Why did you look at the sunset?'Philip answered with his mouth full:Because I was happy.
quotes.author: W. Somerset Maugham,  Of Human Bondage

quotes.quote: I wanted to hold happiness in reserve, like a bottle of champagne. I postponed it because I was afraid, because I overvalued it, and then I didn't want to use it up, because what do you wish for then?
quotes.author: Curtis Sittenfeld,  The Man of My Dreams

quotes.quote: There is nothing worse for the lying soul than the mirror of reality.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: The negation of severe suffering was the nearest approach to happiness I expected to know. Besides, I seemed to hold two lives - the life of thought, and that of reality.
quotes.author: Charlotte BrontÃ«,  Villette

quotes.quote: when happiness makes a guest appearance in one's life,it's important to make the most of it.It may not stay around for long and when it has gone wouldn't it be terrible to think that all the time one could have been happy was wasted worrying when the happiness would be taken away.
quotes.author: Marian Keyes,  Watermelon

quotes.quote: She tried to act as though it were nothing to go to the library alone. But her happiness betrayed her. Her smile could not be restrained, and it spread from her tightly pressed mouth, to her round cheeks, almost to the hair ribbons tied in perky bows over her ears.
quotes.author: Maud Hart Lovelace,  Betsy and Tacy Go Downtown

quotes.quote: Live in this moment ... for it is the only moment we have!
quotes.author: Stephen Richards

quotes.quote: The quickest way to experiencing the peace inside, is to learn to recognize when I am not at peace.
quotes.author: James Patrick McDonald

quotes.quote: Love, I thought to myself abstractedly. Not 'This is love' or 'Is this love?' Not a sentence, not a certainty, not a thought with moving parts or direction. Just love, all of it, as it is. Whether it's enough or not. Wthether it's real or we're making it up. However shoddy it gets, or bent out of shape. It's still extraordinary. However foolish, however vain. However badly it ends. Love.
quotes.author: Julian Gough,  Juno & Juliet

quotes.quote: Happily Single"is recognizing that you don't need or want to be rescued from your life by a handsome prince because your life is pretty awesome, as is.
quotes.author: Mandy Hale,  The Single Woman: Life, Love, and a Dash of Sass

quotes.quote: If you wait for a cake to be given to you so you will be happy- then you will be happy when someone gives you a cake. But if you buy a cake (or bake one) for yourself so you will be happy, you have found the way of happiness.
quotes.author: C. JoyBell C.

quotes.quote: One should cultivate good habits of memory, for it is capable of making existence a Paradise or an Inferno.
quotes.author: Baltasar GraciÃ¡n,  The Art of Worldly Wisdom

quotes.quote: Don't be afraid to be who you are bacause you are the only person who knows you best.
quotes.author: Saredo Ali

quotes.quote: Do not think that one has to be sad in order to be militant, even though the thing one is fighting is abominable.
quotes.author: Michel Foucault,  Anti-Oedipus: Capitalism and Schizophrenia

quotes.quote: Today only the person who no longer believes in a happy ending, only he who has consciously renounced it, is able to live. A happy century does not exist; but there are moments of happiness, and there is freedom in the moment.
quotes.author: Ernst JÃ¼nger,  The Glass Bees

quotes.quote: Sooner or later in life everyone discovers that perfect happiness is unrealizable, but there are few who stop to consider the antithesis; that perfect unhappiness is equally unattainable.
quotes.author: Primo Levi

quotes.quote: Unless you know where you are going then you will not know how to get there.
quotes.author: Stephen Richards

quotes.quote: People will not remember what you did for living,they will remember how you touched them with kindness and loving.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: Maybe happiness too is a metaphor invented on a day of boredom
quotes.author: Gustave Flaubert,  November

quotes.quote: Happiness is what you choose, what you follow, not what follows you. These are the things I have seen, these are the things I now know, these are the things I will carry with me as I go.
quotes.author: Allison Winn Scotch

quotes.quote: Science of happiness lies in our understanding. The secrets of happiness lie in our capacity to expand our heart.
quotes.author: Amit Ray,  Yoga and Vipassana: An Integrated Life Style

quotes.quote: Unhappiness is bondage; therefore, happiness is freedom.
quotes.author: Lauren Oliver,  Delirium

quotes.quote: It's what's in *yourself* that makes you happy or unhappy.
quotes.author: Agatha Christie,  A Murder Is Announced

quotes.quote: I like living, breathing better than working...my art is that of living. Each second, each breath is a work which is inscribed nowhere, which is neither visual nor cerebral, it's a sort of constant euphoria.
quotes.author: Marcel Duchamp

quotes.quote: my child, if you want to have a beautiful and happy life... 2 things you need... learn the art of love and practice it with your beloved one.
quotes.author: Carlos Barrios

quotes.quote: A life of happiness, peace, and love is all within our grasp.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: And from the midst of cheerless gloomI passed to bright unclouded day.
quotes.author: Emily BrontÃ«

quotes.quote: One of the biggest favors that you can do for yourself is to accept your loved ones for who they are, and not be constantly disappointed because they are not who you think they should be.
quotes.author: Jennifer O'Neill,  Inspirational Quotes

quotes.quote: In pursuit of happiness, smart people often end up dumbing down themselves.
quotes.author: Erol Ozan

quotes.quote: We are young, but We already know that in life's great game those who are most unhappy are those who haven't taken the risk to be happy. And I don't want to be one of those
quotes.author: Guillaume Musso,  Que serais-je sans toi?

quotes.quote: To find out what one is fitted to do, and to secure an opportunity to do it, is the key to happiness.
quotes.author: John Dewey

quotes.quote: The only thing limiting your aspiration is your imagination.
quotes.author: Stephen Richards

quotes.quote: I think that fame removes true happiness. Because when you are famous, people know you for who they think you are and when you are happy, it's because people have met you and see you for who you really are. Of course, if you are not a great person, it's better to be famous. But if you have greatness, it's better to not be famous.
quotes.author: C. JoyBell C.

quotes.quote: Happiness is the best revenge
quotes.author: Jacki Kane,  Sass Mouth: Destiny is a Joke

quotes.quote: Maybe this is a characteristic of happy people. An ability to be entertained by the world.
quotes.author: Clare Morrall,  The Language Of Others

quotes.quote: When you win and the other fellow loses, what do you see? A losing face. There is great joy in losing and making the other person win and have a happy face. Who will be the happiest person? The one who brings happiness to others.
quotes.author: Swami Satchidananda

quotes.quote: There are hours for rest, and hours for wakefulness; nights for sobriety and nights for drunkenness--(if only so that possession of the former allows us to discern the latter when we have it; for sad as it is, no human body can be happily drunk all the time).
quotes.author: Roman Payne,  Rooftop Soliloquy

quotes.quote: Here at last is her smile: burn it into your memory; you won't see it often.
quotes.author: Junot DÃ­az,  The Brief Wondrous Life of Oscar Wao

quotes.quote: It's all about the smiles!
quotes.author: Emmy Swain

quotes.quote: There is no duty we so much underrate as the duty of being happy.
quotes.author: Robert Louis Stevenson,  An Apology for Idlers

quotes.quote: Happiness is a strange thing. It is something I tend to recognize only after it has passed, when I realize I miss it.
quotes.author: Claire Holden Rothman,  The Heart Specialist

quotes.quote: JOY goes against the foundations of mathematics: it multiplies when we divide.
quotes.author: Paulo Coelho

quotes.quote: If you see the world and yourself through a lens smudged by negativity then you'll find much misery. If you look outwards and inwards through lens brightened by positivity you'll find much to be happy and appreciative about.
quotes.author: Henrik Edberg,  The 7 Timeless Habits of Happiness

quotes.quote: Hide yourself in God, so when a man wants to find you he will have to go there first.
quotes.author: Shannon L. Alder

quotes.quote: Berhentilah mencari laki-laki untuk membuatmu baagia.Mulailah menjadi perempuan bahagia yang dicari laki-laki.
quotes.author: Christian Simamora,  Guilty Pleasure

quotes.quote: Make the most of every moment. Get excited about every little thing. Why not? Why not have your wonderful moment of excited anticipation? Why not be happy NOW? This is my greatest challenge, but something I'm pouring my heart into: learning how to enjoy what I have, right here, right now. Every moment is precious and although sometimes I struggle to see it, I see it more and more every day.
quotes.author: Bethenny Frankel,  A Place of Yes: 10 Rules for Getting Everything You Want Out of Life

quotes.quote: The road is long, we carry on, try to have fun in the meantime.
quotes.author: Lana Del Rey

quotes.quote: Again, I am surprised why people seek to eliminate lust and cling to love; as they wish to ignore happiness and cleave unto joy! Now, now, let's not sugar-coat things! Lust has a lot more to do with life and what is the good of life if you do not carry much lust inside of you at all times? And joy is a noble thing, but happiness though fleeting can be found every day and in every small little way!
quotes.author: C. JoyBell C.

quotes.quote: Today is Your Day to Dance Lightly with Life. It Really Is.
quotes.author: Jonathan Lockwood Huie

quotes.quote: They luxuriated in the feeling of deep and all pervading satisfaction, a feeling of knowing absolutely that all was well with the world and them and that the world was not only their oyster it was also their linguine with clam sauce. Not only were all things possible, but all things were theirs.
quotes.author: Hubert Selby Jr.,  Requiem for a Dream

quotes.quote: There were times when I lifted my face to the sky, stretched my arms wide to the winter night, and laughed out loud, so happy was I.The memory of it makes me laugh now, but not from happiness.Be careful what you show the world.You never know when the wolf is watching.
quotes.author: Jennifer Donnelly,  Revolution

quotes.quote: And I don't believe in such a thing as "happily ever after". There's only happily every now and then. I find the hardest trick is to recognize the now-and-thens, and to bask in them when they come. Happiness is a choice we make, like how to wear our hair, or having coffee with breakfast and tea at night.
quotes.author: Cindy Bonner,  The Passion of Dellie O'Barr

quotes.quote: Without friends you have nothing!
quotes.author: Stephen Richards

quotes.quote: The true test of one's mettle is how many times you will try before you give up.
quotes.author: Stephen Richards

quotes.quote: The tragedy is that what you disapprove of in others is the very thing you disapprove of in yourself.
quotes.author: Stephen Richards

quotes.quote: Science teaches to think but love teaches to smile.
quotes.author: Santosh Kalwar

quotes.quote: We never realize just how many other lives we can help when their paths cross our own.
quotes.author: Wil Zeus,  Sun Beyond the Clouds

quotes.quote: I think my quarry is illusion. I war against magic. I believe that, though illusion often cheers and comforts, it ultimately and invariably weakens and constricts the spirit.
quotes.author: Irvin D. Yalom,  Love's Executioner and Other Tales of Psychotherapy

quotes.quote: It makes no difference where you go, there you are. And it makes no difference what you have, there's always more to want. Until you are happy with who you are, you will never be happy because of what you have.
quotes.author: Zig Ziglar

quotes.quote: Always try to be joyful and proactively benign to the people. By doing so everyday, people have no control at all over my mood.
quotes.author: Toba Beta,  Betelgeuse Incident: Insiden Bait Al-Jauza

quotes.quote: Stop wasting your time looking for the key to happiness... the door is open and unlocked... just walk through it.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: You can be right or you can be happy.
quotes.author: Gerald G. Jampolsky,  Love Is Letting Go of Fear

quotes.quote: She was happy, she knew she was happy, and knew she ought to be happy.
quotes.author: Jane Austen,  Emma

quotes.quote: Ah, happiness courts the light so we deem the world is gay. But misery hides aloof so we deem that misery there is none.
quotes.author: Herman Melville,  Bartleby the Scrivener

quotes.quote: There is a fine line between compassion and a victim mentality. Compassion though is a healing force and comes from a place of kindness towards yourself. Playing the victim is a toxic waste of time that not only repels other people, but also robs the victim of ever knowing true happiness.
quotes.author: Bronnie Ware,  The Top Five Regrets of the Dying: A Life Transformed by the Dearly Departing

quotes.quote: The goal of prayer is to live all of my life and speak all of my words in the joyful awareness of the presence of God.Prayer becomes real when we grasp the reality and goodness of God's constant presence with 'the real me.' Jesus lived his everyday life in conscious awareness of his Father.
quotes.author: John Ortberg Jr.,  The Me I Want to Be: Becoming God's Best Version of You

quotes.quote: A truly Christian love, either to God or men, is a humble broken-hearted love. The desires of the saints, however earnest, are humble desires. Their hope is a humble hope; and their joy, even when it is unspeakable and full of glory, is a humble broken-hearted joy, and leaves the Christian more poor in spirit, and more like a little child, and more disposed to a universal lowliness of behaviour.
quotes.author: Jonathan Edwards,  The Religious Affections

quotes.quote: There is a difference between talented people and gifted people.Talented people are good AT something; Gifted people ARE that something.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: It is only possible to live happily ever after on a daily basis.
quotes.author: Margaret Wander Bonanno

quotes.quote: Hearts will break and people will hurt you, darling.' Her mother said. 'But when you let those people control your outlook on the life, you only allow them to have a greater hold on your happiness. Once you accept the fact that every day is a new day to begin again, life becomes a much easier path to walk.
quotes.author: Courtney Giardina,  Holding on to Georgia

quotes.quote: if it makes you happy, then why the hell are you so sad?
quotes.author: Sheryl Crow

quotes.quote: You know what my father told me when I was little, one day, when he found me crying? He told me that God gave people a fixed number of tears and are of two kinds: tears of sadness and tears of happiness. And that I should not waste my tears elsewhere, but keep them for the moments of happiness. Would be a shame to not have tears to cry then ...
quotes.author: Irina Binder,  Fluturi

quotes.quote: You will realize one day that all the money in the world cannot buy you happiness. Nor can it make you a person of good character.
quotes.author: Richelle E. Goodrich,  Smile Anyway: Quotes, Verse, & Grumblings for Every Day of the Year

quotes.quote: I've always believed that happiness is just around the corner. The trick is fining the right corner.
quotes.author: Eric Weiner,  The Geography of Bliss: One Grump's Search for the Happiest Places in the World

quotes.quote: People, he thought, were as hungry for a sight of joy as he had always been--for a moment's relief from that gray load of suffering which seemed so inexplicable and unnecessary. He had never been able to understand why men should be unhappy.
quotes.author: Ayn Rand,  Atlas Shrugged

quotes.quote: I learned from a very young age that if I persued the things that truly excited me, that they would reward in more important ways, like happiness.
quotes.author: Brandon Boyd

quotes.quote: I do not care about happiness simply because I believe that joy is something worth fighting for.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

quotes.quote: The decision is mine, and I choose happiness
quotes.author: Malori Howell

quotes.quote: Pure joy is rare. That's why for every meal I eat a really bloody steak.
quotes.author: Bauvard,  Some Inspiration for the Overenthusiastic

quotes.quote: There is no happiness in love, except at the end of an English novel.
quotes.author: Anthony Trollope,  Barchester Towers

quotes.quote: People will always notice something about you. It might be the way you walk or the way you talk, or just simply your personality. Live each day in the way you want to be remembered. Live in such a way that people will be inspired by those unique qualities that you have and strive to live better lives for themselves.
quotes.author: Amaka Imani Nkosazana

quotes.quote: I want that. I want that awful intense and serious unhappiness, cos then I might feel better, and then I might be happy.
quotes.author: David Thewlis,  The Late Hector Kipling

quotes.quote: She still cared for me, and the best way I could make amends to her was to be happy.I do have a knack for finding great women.
quotes.author: Craig Ferguson,  American on Purpose: The Improbable Adventures of an Unlikely Patriot

quotes.quote: Our purest form of joy comes when people we envy get hurt. That most genuine form of joy.
quotes.author: Chuck Palahniuk,  Haunted

quotes.quote: If you're not getting happier as you get older, then you're fuckin' up
quotes.author: Ani DiFranco

quotes.quote: Everyone has a right to be a little happy, asshole.
quotes.author: John Irving,  Last Night in Twisted River

quotes.quote: An intelligent person, looking out of his eyes and hearkening in his ears, with a smile on his face all the time, will get more true education than many another in a life of heroic vigils".
quotes.author: Robert Louis Stevenson,  An Apology for Idlers

quotes.quote: Many married women who have deliberately spurned the "hour"of childbearing are unhappy and frustrated. They never discovered the joys of marriage because they refused to surrender to the obligation of their state. In saving themselves, they lost themselves!
quotes.author: Fulton J. Sheen,  Seven Words of Jesus and Mary: Lessons from Cana and Calvary

quotes.quote: In the whole history of the world there is but one thing that money cannot buy...to wit--the wag of a dog's tail.
quotes.author: Josh Billings

quotes.quote: Where happiness was not a possibility, the illusion of it was always more important.
quotes.author: Colum McCann,  Zoli

quotes.quote: We try to fix the outside so much, but our control of the outer world is limited, temporary, and often, illusory.
quotes.author: Matthieu Ricard,  Happiness: A Guide to Developing Life's Most Important Skill

quotes.quote: Suffering just means you're having a bad dream. Happiness means you're having a good dream. Enlightenment means getting out of the dream altogether.
quotes.author: Jed McKenna

quotes.quote: What is your idea of earthly happiness? To be vindicated in my own lifetime.
quotes.author: Christopher Hitchens,  Hitch-22: A Memoir

quotes.quote: You have to appreciate where you have come from to know who you are in the present and whom you would like to be in the future.
quotes.author: Truth Devour,  Unrequited

quotes.author: Deborah Day,  BE HAPPY NOW!

quotes.quote: Happiness doesn't have to be chased...it merely has to be chosen.
quotes.author: Mandy Hale,  The Single Woman: Life, Love, and a Dash of Sass

I've known many an invalid who has suffered worse and been cut off from life much more . . . and they've managed to lead happy contented lives. quotes.author: Agatha Christie,  A Murder Is Announced

quotes.author: Elizabeth Gilbert,  Committed: A Skeptic Makes Peace with Marriage

quotes.quote: Sometimes you just have to jump in a mud puddle because it's there. Never get so old that you forget about having fun.
quotes.author: Tom Giaquinto,  Be A Good Human

quotes.quote: This moment is yours and yours alone! Take charge, seize this moment and allow it to propel you to the high levels of an empowered life. Allow upon this fertile moment to be planted the seeds of your happiness and success.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: .. she believed a great happiness awaited her somewhere, and for this reason she remained calm as the days flew by.
quotes.author: Gyula KrÃºdy,  Sunflower

quotes.quote: Easily mistaken, it is not about a love for adversity, it is about knowing a strength and a faith so great that adversity, in all its adverse manifestations, hardly even exists.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

quotes.quote: Am I as spontaneously kind to God as I used to be, or am I only expecting God to be kind to me? Am I full of the little things that cheer His heart over me, or am I whimpering because things are going hardly with me? There is no joy in the soul that has forgotten what God prizes.
quotes.author: Oswald Chambers

quotes.quote: Challenges in life can either enrich you or poison you. You are the one who decides.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: Why did I hope we would be happy abroad? A change of environment is that traditional fallacy upon which doomed loves, and lungs, rely.
quotes.author: Vladimir Nabokov

quotes.quote: You can be happy with money and you can be wretched with it. It depends on what kind of person you are. -- A Prologue to Love
quotes.author: Taylor Caldwell

quotes.quote: Happiness is spiritual, born of truth and love. It is unselfish; therefore it cannot exist alone, but requires all mankind to share it.
quotes.author: Mary Baker Eddy

quotes.quote: Dear me! how happy and good we'd be, if we had no worries!
quotes.author: Louisa May Alcott,  Little Women

quotes.quote: The British do not expect happiness. I had the impression, all the time that I lived there, that they do not want to be happy; they want to be right.
quotes.author: Quentin Crisp

quotes.quote: Taking a risk to survive isn't that impressive. Taking a risk to be happy, that takes guts.
quotes.author: Sarah Noffke,  Revived

quotes.quote: Happiness is not a state of being. Happiness is a vector, it is movement.
quotes.author: Neal Shusterman,  Bruiser

quotes.quote: People who say that money can't buy happiness just don't know where to shop.
quotes.author: Kathy Lette

quotes.quote: Happiness is a big joke; let us laugh at it loud.

quotes.quote: But the happiest people are the ones who understand that good things occur when one allows them to.

quotes.quote: ... too much brooding, not enough doing.
quotes.author: Timothy Findley

quotes.quote: Those who wish to sing always find a song.
quotes.author: Swedish Proverb

quotes.author: April Genevieve Tucholke,  Between the Devil and the Deep Blue Sea

quotes.quote: Then the world will be for the common people, and the sounds of happiness will reach the deepest springs. Ah! Come! People of every land, how can you not be roused.

quotes.quote: The formula of happiness and success is just, being actually yourself, in the most vivid possible way you can.
quotes.author: Meryl Streep

quotes.quote: You don't have to be happy to smile.
quotes.author: Daniel Willey

quotes.quote: Why sadness was created?So we could rest from laughing.
quotes.author: Nelson M. Lubao

quotes.quote: I don't know whether it is beautiful or sad, that I find such blissful happiness within the confines of my own mind, more so than I do in the reality that surrounds me.

quotes.quote: Joy is but the sign that creative emotion is fulfilling its purpose.
quotes.author: Charles Du Bos

quotes.quote: A homeless man visited my store today. The few quarters that he had in his pocket he invested on books. I offered him free books, but he insisted on giving me his quarters. quotes.author: Besa Kosova,  Raindrops

quotes.quote: Joy blooms where minds and hearts are open.

quotes.quote: You will have fewer regrets in life if you start focusing and taking responsiblity for where you are and where you want to be.

quotes.quote: Don't dare to dream big, just dream BIG!

quotes.quote: Happiness is inseparably connected with decent, clean behavior.
quotes.author: Boyd K. Packer

quotes.quote: Life isn't all grand, but it isn't all miserable either. There's both sweet and sour in every day. So why focus on the ugly when you can gaze at what's beautiful? Concentrate on the good.

quotes.quote: Lord, make me nowAs happy as the field.With flowers enriched...
quotes.author: Eileen A. Soper

quotes.quote: Sweetest smile is made saddest tear-drop!
quotes.author: Edwin Arnold

quotes.quote: Don't nourish your fears more than you nourish your hopes.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli

quotes.quote: Sex parties, alcohol and drugs lost their appeal to Sven after a while. Music never did, in his continual search for that sober connection--intimacy with one person over a long period of time, as opposed to periods of intimacy with a bunch of random faces.

quotes.quote: A day unemployed is like a bagel- even when it's bad, it's still pretty good...

quotes.quote: There is nothing around me but money, money, money.
quotes.author: Stephen Richards

quotes.quote: Happiness had never been like this before. Now it came like sun showers, the sun and the rain together. Happiness was happier than it had been - sharp, piercing, and snatched, like a breath while swimming in surf.

quotes.quote: The happiness of love is in action; its test is what one is willing to do for others.
quotes.author: Lew Wallace,  Ben-Hur: A Tale of the Christ

quotes.quote: The only way I can be angry at you is when I have thought, said, or done something that is unkind in my own opinion.
quotes.author: Byron Katie

quotes.quote: He saw in happiness the seeds of independence, and in independence the seeds of revolt.
quotes.author: Mervyn Peake,  Titus Groan

quotes.quote: If you are a Buddhist, inspire yourself by thinking of the bodhisattva. If you are a Christian, think of the Christ, who came not to be served by others but to serve them in joy, in peace, and in generosity. quotes.quote: Happiness is a choice. Peace is a state of mind. Both are free!

quotes.quote: If we lose all of our wealth and are only left with love then, indeed, we shall never be poor.

quotes.quote: All things, even the deepest sorrow or the most profound happiness are all temporary. Hope is fuel for the soul, without hope, forward motion ceases.
quotes.author: Landon Parham,  First Night of Summer

quotes.quote: These men are worth your tears. You are not worth their merriment.
quotes.author: Wilfred Owen,  The Poems Of Wilfred Owen

quotes.quote: If you are a dreamer, come in,If you are a dreamer, a wisher, a liar,A hope-er, a pray-er, a magic bean buyer...If you're a pretender, come sit by my fireFor we have some flax-golden tales to spin. Come in!Come in!
quotes.author: Shel Silverstein

quotes.quote: The man with toothache thinks everyone happy whose teeth are sound.The poverty stricken man makes the same mistake about the rich man.
quotes.author: George Bernard Shaw

quotes.quote: Honest, open communication is the only street that leads us into the real world... We then begin to grow as never before. And once we are on this road, happiness cannot be far away.
quotes.author: John Powell,  Will the Real Me Please Stand Up?: 25 Guidelines for Good Communication

quotes.quote: I drink to the general joy o' the whole table."Macbeth
quotes.author: William Shakespeare,  Macbeth

quotes.quote: Unhappiness is caused when we cannot let go of our memories.
quotes.author: Jed Rubenfeld,  The Interpretation of Murder

quotes.quote: The highest prize we can receive for creative work is the joy of being creative. Creative effort spent for any other reason than the joy of being in that light filled space, love, god, whatever we want to call it, is lacking in integrity. . .

quotes.quote: Never surrender to you're passions. Dream and live to excess.

quotes.quote: You are human, so stop acting as if though you are a sheep and start thinking for yourself.

quotes.quote: I only seem negative to the fortunate. That's because I show the less fortunate that they aren't less fortunate after all.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

quotes.quote: You would not want to be responsible for someone else's happiness, so please do not hold someone else responsible for yours!
quotes.author: Jennifer O'Neill,  Inspirational Quotes

quotes.author: Kristen Crockett,  The Gift of Past Relationships

quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

quotes.quote: Happiness is attained, not through self-interest, but through unconditional fidelity in endless love of eternal light.
quotes.author: Aaron Cohen

quotes.quote: To live long and achieve happiness, cultivate the art of radiating happiness.
quotes.author: Malcolm Forbes

quotes.quote: Happiness, it has been observed, is best achieved by those who have been most unhappy heretofore.

quotes.quote: I Am In Love With Myself, With My Heart.

quotes.quote: Today I am even richer.
quotes.author: Stephen Richards

quotes.quote: It is in doing things and not reading about them that results come about.

quotes.author: Laura Munson,  This Is Not The Story You Think It Is...: A Season of Unlikely Happiness

quotes.quote: Nourishing yourself in a way that helps you blossom in the direction you want to go is attainable, and you are worth the effort.
quotes.author: Deborah Day

quotes.author: Charles Alexander Eastman

quotes.quote: It is only in sorrow bad weather masters us; in joy we face the storm and defy it.
quotes.author: Amelia Barr

quotes.quote: And he, like many jaded people, had few pleasures left in life save good food and drink.

quotes.quote: I think instead [of happiness] we should be working for contentment... an inner sense of fulfillment that's relatively independent of external circumstances.
quotes.author: Andrew Weil

quotes.author: Orson Scott Card,  Sarah

quotes.quote: Frugality, I've learned, has its own cost, one that sometimes lasts forever.
quotes.author: Nicholas Sparks,  The Wedding

quotes.quote: Mother earth cried so much that she has pool of tears more than the land of happiness.
quotes.author: Santosh Kalwar

quotes.author: Jerry Spinelli,  Milkweed

quotes.quote: You are so intense. Like a storm. It's shocking how intense you are.
quotes.author: Francesca Lia Block,  Blood Roses

quotes.quote: Helping others is the secret sauce to a happy life.
quotes.author: Todd Stocker,  Refined: Turning Pain Into Purpose

quotes.author: Sylvia Plath,  The Unabridged Journals of Sylvia Plath

quotes.quote: The man is happiest who lives from day to day and asks no more, garnering the simple goodness of life.
quotes.author: Euripides

quotes.quote: Christopher McCandless:"I will miss you too, but you are wrong if you think that the joy of life comes principally from the joy of human relationships. quotes.author: Shunryu Suzuki

quotes.author: Wilhelm Reich,  Children of the Future: On the Prevention of Sexual Pathology

quotes.quote: There is no happily-ever-after to run to. We have to work for happiness.
quotes.author: Mary Balogh,  Simply Magic

quotes.author: Geneen Roth

quotes.quote: The key to ultimate happiness and fulfillment lies within our own transformation. The more we learn and grow and evolve as individuals, the more we will find happiness and satisfaction in relationships, work and life.

quotes.author: Angie Smith,  Letting Go of Perfect: Women, Expectations, and Authenticity

quotes.quote: I am seldom otherwise than happy while watching in the chamber of death... . I see a repose that neither earth nor hell can break, and I feel an assurance of the endless and shadowless hereafter--the Eternity they have entered--where life is boundless in its duration, and love in its sympathy, and joy in its fulness.
quotes.author: Emily BrontÃ«,  Wuthering Heights

quotes.quote: We think a wise person is someone who solves problems. Truth is, a wise person is someone who avoids problems.
quotes.author: Prem Rawat

quotes.author: Rainer Maria Rilke,  Duino Elegies

quotes.quote: I hate going through this when we just found...,"his voice trailed off."Found what?""Each other,"he finished, half-smiling.

quotes.quote: I am in an altogether new world now. I can think of nothing more wonderful. It is a real touch of all that heaven means.

quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: Some people would rather live in a hell they've got used to than in a paradise they've never experienced before.
quotes.author: Urania Sarri,  Gate Deadlock

quotes.author: Lorraine Zago Rosenthal,  Other Words for Love

quotes.quote: Men spend their lives in anticipations,--in determining to be vastly happy at some period when they have time. But the present time has one advantage over every other--it is our own. Past opportunities are gone, future have not come. We may lay in a stock of pleasures, as we would lay in a stock of wine; but if we defer the tasting of them too long, we shall find that both are soured by age.
quotes.author: Charles Caleb Colton

quotes.quote: I enjoy melancholic music and art. They take me to places I don't normally get to go.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

quotes.quote: Unhappiness can be like a virus spreading from one person, to the next person, to the next one and so on. When someone is mean or rude to you, do not let their unhappiness infect your own life. If you are the unhappy one, please quarantine yourself so you do not infect others!
quotes.author: Jennifer O'Neill,  Soul DNA: Your Spiritual Genetic Code Defines Your Purpose

quotes.quote: Money can't buy happiness but it can buy a huge yacht that sails right next to it.
quotes.author: David Lee Roth

quotes.quote: If there was one thing that life has taught me, it's to accept the most foolish and unthinkable happiness.

quotes.quote: The secret of happiness is something to do

quotes.quote: There's the risk of being loved...and that would keep me from being happy.
quotes.author: Albert Camus,  A Happy Death

quotes.quote: And all the best words together couldn't hold the happiness.

quotes.author: Jess C. Scott,  Trouble

quotes.quote: A truly radical resolution would be to embrace existence just as it is, as the only thing that matters, to proclaim that the world itself is heaven, made for our total enjoyment and fulfillment...
quotes.author: CrimethInc.,  Expect Resistance: A Field Manual
